LightningComponentBundle.description: Interactive bubble chart: a scatter plot where a third numeric field drives bubble area (sqrt-scaled). Click bubbles to navigate to records.

property.name: soqlQuery
property.label: SOQL Query
property.description: SOQL query to fetch bubble data (used if Object API Name is not set)
property.placeholder: SELECT Id, Amount, Probability, Forecast_Units__c, Name FROM Opportunity WHERE Amount > 0

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object for the typed getXYData server path and record navigation

property.name: filterClause
property.label: Filter Clause
property.description: Optional WHERE clause appended on the server path

property.name: xAxisField
property.label: X-Axis Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field for X-axis

property.name: xAxisLabel
property.label: X-Axis Label
property.description: Display label for X-axis (defaults to field name)

property.name: yAxisField
property.label: Y-Axis Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field for Y-axis

property.name: yAxisLabel
property.label: Y-Axis Label
property.description: Display label for Y-axis (defaults to field name)

property.name: sizeField
property.label: Size Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field driving bubble area

property.name: sizeLabel
property.label: Size Label
property.description: Display label for the size dimension (defaults to field name)

property.name: labelField
property.label: Label Field
property.description: Optional field used as each bubble's tooltip label

property.name: recordIdField
property.label: Record ID Field
property.description: Field containing the record ID for navigation
